source_title: Spectral Asymmetry and Index Theory on Manifolds with Generalised Hyperbolic Cusps
title: Equivariant index formula and explicit spectral cusp contribution on manifolds with admissible cusps
core_obligations: The general invertible-at-infinity index theorem HW21a and one-dimensional spectral decomposition are priors. The actual new work establishes the cusp hypotheses with a Liouville unitary transformation, signed Green-operator inverse satisfying complementary APS domains and uniform spectral-gap bounds, then constructs the cusp heat kernel from the Dirichlet/Friedrichs splitting and Sturm-Liouville spectral measures. Matching density factors and positive/negative tangential spectra produces the explicit convergent delocalised cusp contribution.
